lucas: Originating RC: rc-2026-03-21-standby (tag rc-standby-01). Built and pushed: registry:redwood/inference:rc-standby-01; model=v2.4.6-rc1 (quant=q4f16). Request ops pin, KV warm, and 01:00-02:00 UTC quiet window. Canary plan below.

deploy-bot: [CI] RC created: rc-standby-01 (build 999). Artifacts uploaded to s3://ci/rc-999/. KV-warm queued (kv-999).

anika: Staging smoke done. Minor diff in one eval case but within tolerance. Recommend model routing prefer low-latency racks.

dave: Rollback snippet (kept at hand):
```
kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=redwood/inference:stable-2026-03-12 -n prod
deploy-bot rollback --id rc-standby-01 --reason "telemetry-anomaly"
```

sheriff-ops: I'm on-call for the window and will be primary. Deadman set: auto-cut at errors >1% sustained for 3m. I'll be at console 00:50 UTC.

lucas: Canary plan: 0.5% for 10m -> 5% for 20m -> 50% for 15m -> 100% if green. Thresholds: p95 < 170ms, errors < 0.7%. After final promote we'll pin artifacts and update release notes.

deploy-bot: [kv-warm] started: warming ~650k keys, threads=5
[log] completed in 1m 35s, cache ~820MB

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary 0.5% -> rc-standby-01 at 2026-03-22T01:00:05Z. Initial metrics: p95=139ms, errors=0.06%

anika: Holding 10m. No anomalies. Proceed to 5%.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 5% complete at 2026-03-22T01:12:20Z. Monitoring continues.

dave: All infra checks normal. Ready for 50% after hold.

sheriff-ops: Approving final ramp if metrics stay stable.

lucas: Promoting to 100% now and pinning registry:redwood/inference:rc-standby-01 and model:v2.4.6-rc1.

deploy-bot: [deploy] promote -> 100% at 2026-03-22T01:38:40Z. Final snapshot: p95=151ms, errors=0.10%, token-cost uplift=2.9%

lucas: Promotion complete. Release notes will be updated and email sent. Closing thread. :tada:
